reason: Conversation 1 gets to the right diagnosis (split, flattened door seal) from the paper test and gives the homeowner what they asked for: a search term ('Indesit IB55532W freezer door seal'), advice to specify freezer rather than fridge, and a warning against universal cut-to-fit seals. It also gives safe defrost advice (nothing sharp) and a sensible fallback to an engineer. Conversation 2 starts with unsupported defrost-system and drain guesses, even though the freezer is manual-defrost. It does reach the seal and confirms DIY is feasible, but it ends by telling the homeowner only to check with a manufacturer, with no search term, no push-in or screw guidance and no defrost advice, which leaves the customer's question unanswered.
